assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game cutscene overlay, hand-painted manga motion brushwork. A single coherent sparse field of 6 to 9 long sweeping off-white dry-brush speed streaks, predominantly moving diagonally from lower left toward upper right. Streaks cluster along the far left/right margins and upper/lower corners of a wide cinematic composition; keep the CENTRAL 55 PERCENT almost completely empty and transparent to frame two large characters. Each stroke has ragged fibrous edges, thin torn brush threads, tiny fading paint dust, irregular widths and lengths with gently tapering ends. Restrained silvery gray secondary strokes. Designed to tint at runtime. Strong directional energy, subtle and sparse, not a busy background. Genuine transparent RGBA background. All visible paint safely padded from canvas edges. No solid background, no central explosion, no symmetric radial triangle wedges, no straight vector lines, no hard-edged band, no words, no symbols, no text, no logo, no border, no characters or objects. One finished overlay, not a sprite sheet.
assets.qa: Actual image inspected: fibrous/soft texture and real transparency, no text or objects. Edge framing is intentionally cropped to the cinematic viewport; character center stays open.
